zh.title: AnimaWings 啟動司法重整　以兩架 A320 維持營運並調整航班
zh.summary: 這家羅馬尼亞航空公司表示，技術與成本壓力促使其啟動司法重整；目前由兩架 A320 執飛，部分航班可能調整或取消。
body: AnimaWings 於 2026 年 9 月 30 日宣布啟動司法重整程序，目標是在法律框架下維持營運、穩定現金流並重整債務。公司將此決定歸因於機隊技術問題，以及燃油與整體營運成本帶來的壓力。
公司表示目前有兩架 Airbus A320 可投入營運，班表將依可用運能調整；個別航班可能變更或取消。受影響旅客將依規定取得替代安排或退款。
AeroTime 報導，AnimaWings 的機隊已由八架縮至兩架，六架租賃的 A220-300 已退出營運。司法重整不等同停止營業，公司稱航班與旅客服務仍會持續。

en.title: AnimaWings enters judicial reorganization, operating two A320s with schedule changes
en.summary: The Romanian airline says technical and cost pressures led it to seek judicial reorganization; two A320s remain available and some flights may change or be canceled.
body: AnimaWings announced on September 30, 2026 that it had initiated judicial reorganization to protect operating continuity, stabilize cash flow and restructure its obligations under court supervision. It cited technical fleet problems together with fuel and broader operating-cost pressure.

The airline says two Airbus A320s are currently available. Its schedule will be adjusted to match that capacity, with isolated changes or cancellations possible. Affected passengers are to receive alternatives or refunds under the applicable rules.

AeroTime reports that the carrier's fleet has contracted from eight aircraft to two and that six leased A220-300s have left its operation. Judicial reorganization is not a shutdown, and AnimaWings says flights and passenger support will continue.

facts.claim: AnimaWings initiated judicial reorganization on 2026-09-30 while stating that operations would continue.
The airline said two Airbus A320s were currently available and that isolated schedule changes or cancellations were possible.
AeroTime reported that six leased A220-300s had left the operation as the fleet shrank from eight aircraft to two.
